title: Author The Hollow Beneath Emberfall starter module fixture
description:
Author the first-party starter adventure module - The Hollow Beneath Emberfall - as structured immutable module source using the new schema.

This should create a real fixture/module pack that can be loaded by the module loader and referenced by a campaign-owned adventure run / module binding.
design:
Use the outline bead as source material.

Do not over-polish prose at the expense of structured coverage. The module's main job is to exercise the engine path for authored scenario content. The fixture is immutable authored source; it carries no campaign progress fields.

Naming (ADR 0012): module title is The Hollow Beneath Emberfall; the Emberfall setting stays separate campaign-template content. EMBERFALL_HOLLOW is the legacy conflated sample, not this new fixture.
acceptance_criteria:
- The Hollow Beneath Emberfall starter module is represented in the adventure module schema as immutable authored source.
- The module includes hooks, locations, scenes, NPCs, objectives, secrets/clues, encounters, treasure/reward, and ending states (as authored definitions, not progress).
- The module references rules-pack content where appropriate instead of copying mechanical truth.
- The module validates through the module-pack loader.
- Tests cover loading the module fixture and resolving its internal references.
- The module remains separate from the Emberfall campaign-template/setting content.
notes: Fixture at packages/core/data/adventure-modules/hollow-beneath-emberfall/adventure-module.json; PR #269 open (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/269). Awaiting review/merge. Loads via loadAdventureModuleFromDir; refs resolve against constructed stack. eh54.7.3 must reconcile rulesRef resolution against the shipped SRD pack (kind-prefixed keys). Unblocks eshyra-eh54.7.3.
close_reason: Merged via PR #269. Starter module fixture at packages/core/data/adventure-modules/eshyra_hollow-beneath-emberfall/; shared adventureModuleDirName helper added. Unblocks eshyra-eh54.7.3.
